sub_graphs.title: EIP-1234: Difficulty Bomb Delay Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified difficulty calculation that delays the ice age by 5 million blocks

nodes.label: New Block Pending Difficulty Calculation
nodes.description: Block header being constructed, difficulty not yet computed

nodes.label: Read Current Block Number
nodes.description: Retrieve the block number for the block being created

nodes.label: Check Constantinople Fork Activation
nodes.description: Determine if block.number >= CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM

nodes.label: Pre-Constantinople Rules
nodes.description: Use original block number for difficulty calculation

nodes.label: Post-Constantinople Rules
nodes.description: Use fake_block_number for difficulty calculation

nodes.label: Compute Fake Block Number
nodes.description: Calculate fake_block_number = max(0, block.number - 5,000,000)

nodes.label: Fake Block Number Ready
nodes.description: fake_block_number computed for use in difficulty formula

nodes.label: Compute Block Difficulty
nodes.description: Apply difficulty formula using the appropriate block number (real or fake)

nodes.label: Difficulty Computed
nodes.description: Block difficulty value ready for header

external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner)
external_entities.description: Entity constructing new block with calculated difficulty

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1234: Block Reward Reduction
sub_graphs.description: Models the reduced block reward issuance mechanism from 3 ETH to 2 ETH

nodes.label: Block Finalized
nodes.description: Block has been validated and is ready for reward calculation

nodes.label: Check Reward Rules
nodes.description: Determine if Constantinople reward rules apply

nodes.label: Pre-Constantinople Rewards
nodes.description: Apply 3 ETH base block reward

nodes.label: Post-Constantinople Rewards
nodes.description: Apply 2 ETH base block reward

nodes.label: Compute Base Block Reward
nodes.description: Set base reward to 2 ETH (2,000,000,000,000,000,000 wei)

nodes.label: Count Included Uncles
nodes.description: Determine number of uncle blocks included in this block

nodes.label: Compute Nephew Reward
nodes.description: Calculate nephew bonus as base_reward / 32 per uncle

nodes.label: Compute Uncle Rewards
nodes.description: Calculate uncle rewards as ((8-k) * base_reward) / 8 where k = block.number - uncle.number

nodes.label: All Rewards Computed
nodes.description: Block reward, nephew reward, and uncle rewards calculated

nodes.label: Credit Coinbase Account
nodes.description: Add computed rewards to miner's coinbase account balance

nodes.label: Rewards Applied to State
nodes.description: All reward amounts credited to respective accounts

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1234: Block Difficulty and Reward Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of blocks against the modified difficulty and reward rules

nodes.label: Block Received for Validation
nodes.description: Block received from peer, pending consensus validation

nodes.label: Extract Block Number
nodes.description: Read block number from block header

nodes.label: Determine Expected Difficulty
nodes.description: Calculate what the difficulty should be using appropriate rules

nodes.label: Compare Header Difficulty
nodes.description: Verify block header difficulty matches expected value

nodes.label: Difficulty Valid
nodes.description: Block difficulty matches expected calculation

nodes.label: Difficulty Invalid
nodes.description: Block difficulty mismatch - block rejected

nodes.label: Verify Reward Application
nodes.description: Check that state transitions include correct reward credits

nodes.label: Rewards Valid
nodes.description: Coinbase credits match expected rewards

nodes.label: Rewards Invalid
nodes.description: Reward mismatch - block rejected

nodes.label: Block Passes EIP-1234 Checks
nodes.description: Block passes difficulty and reward validation

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify the exact CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM value, deferring to the meta-EIP
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Reference EIP-1013 for network-specific fork block numbers

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'approximately 12 months' for delay duration is imprecise given variable block times
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Use the precise 5,000,000 block offset rather than time-based reasoning for formal analysis

implicit_assumptions.description: Block times remain approximately 15 seconds on average for the delay calculation to achieve intended ~12 month delay
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Difficulty bomb delay shorter or longer than intended; may require additional adjustments

implicit_assumptions.description: The 2 ETH reward provides sufficient economic incentive for miners to continue securing the network
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Reduced mining participation could decrease network security and increase 51% attack risk

implicit_assumptions.description: Miners will upgrade to Constantinople-compatible software to receive the (reduced) rewards
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded miners would create invalid blocks and be rejected from the network
